li.label: my animal was glad to see me
li.description: I came home filthy and worn out, and my animal acted like I'd hung the moon.

li.label: warm feet
li.description: My animal sleeps across my feet at night. It snores, but my feet stay warm.

li.label: lost my dinner to an animal
li.description: I looked away for one breath and an animal ate my dinner. Not all of it, just the good part.

li.label: the best bite, stolen
li.description: An animal took the piece I'd been saving for last and swallowed it whole. What a waste of a good bite.

li.label: robbed, adorably
li.description: An animal stole my dinner right off the plate and looked so pleased about it that I couldn't be angry.

li.label: a gift from my animal
li.description: My animal dropped a dead rat at my feet and looked very proud of itself.

li.label: taught my animal a trick
li.description: It took days and pocketfuls of scraps, but my animal does its trick when I ask now. I'm proud of us both.

li.label: my animal knew
li.description: I was feeling low and didn't tell anyone. My animal came and stayed by me anyway.

li.label: my things got chewed
li.description: An animal chewed my things into damp pieces. I know exactly who did it, and it knows I know.

li.label: cleaned up after a larder raid
li.description: One of the animals got into the stores and I was the one who found the mess. The smell stays on your hands all day.

li.label: played with an animal all day
li.description: We ran around until we both fell over, and then we lay in the grass. That was the best part.

li.label: an animal chose me
li.description: One of the animals has taken to me. It follows me everywhere and waits for me at the door.

li.label: told my troubles to an animal
li.description: I told one of the animals everything that's been bothering me. It won't repeat a word of it.

li.label: an animal hates me
li.description: One of the animals hates me. It growls whenever I walk past, and I've never done anything to it.

li.label: company at work
li.description: My animal lay nearby while I worked all day, watching me like I was wonderful.

li.label: my old friend is slowing down
li.description: My old animal is slower to get up every morning, but it still comes to find me.

li.label: new life in the barn
li.description: There are newborns in the barn, tiny and loud and wobbling around in the straw.

li.label: the herd is growing
li.description: There are more animals in the barn now. That's more meat and leather later on.

li.label: my animal stood guard
li.description: A stranger came too close, and my animal stepped between us without being told. I didn't know it would do that for me.

li.label: kept awake by the noise
li.description: My animal spent half the night crying at the dark, and I couldn't sleep.

li.label: noises in the dark
li.description: Every sound outside last night had me sure something was coming for me. I barely slept.

li.label: calls in the dark
li.description: An animal past the fields called all night, and another one farther off answered it. I couldn't sleep.

li.label: something worth hunting
li.description: There's a big, dangerous animal out there. My hand keeps going to my blade.

li.label: saw a great beast
li.description: A huge animal crossed the meadow, slow and calm, paying us no mind. I've been smiling at nothing all day.

li.label: close to a great beast
li.description: I got close enough to smell it, all dust and grass. I've worked with animals all my life and never seen one like it.

li.label: a quiet morning
li.description: I was up before the others and saw an animal standing in the morning mist. It was beautiful.

li.label: watched a herd go by
li.description: A herd went past, taking its time, and I stopped to watch it go by.

li.label: birdsong
li.description: Birds sang in the bushes all morning. For a few hours I forgot to listen for raiders.

li.label: being watched
li.description: A predator out past the fence watched me work all day, the way you'd watch food.

li.label: I felt like prey
li.description: I felt like prey out there today. I keep watching the long grass, waiting for it to move.

li.label: something is eating the crops
li.description: I plant the crops and weed them, and some little animal with no manners comes and eats them.

li.label: fed a wild creature
li.description: A wild animal ate out of my hand today. It was more hungry than scared.

li.label: a wild animal came to me
li.description: A real wild animal came right up to me, and I stayed still, and it sniffed my hand!

li.label: something huge is out there
li.description: I put my hand in one of its footprints and there was room to spare. It's still out there somewhere.

li.label: touched a wild beast
li.description: I walked right up to a wild beast and put my hand on it. The others said I was mad. My heart is still pounding.

li.label: it's still out there
li.description: I saw the beast that mauled me again, out at the tree line. My old wounds ached just from looking at it.

li.label: come and try it
li.description: The beast that mauled me came back. Next time I'll be the one hunting it.

li.label: that beast is back
li.description: The animal that mauled one of ours was seen again. I keep a blade close and I don't walk out alone.

li.label: robbed by a wild animal
li.description: A wild animal walked off with my things in broad daylight, and the others all saw it happen.

li.label: night-time company
li.description: I was out walking in the dark, and a wild animal crossed my path without running off. We keep the same hours, it and I.

li.label: watched a fight in the meadow
li.description: Two big males crashed heads in the meadow for most of the afternoon. Best entertainment we've had all season.
